entities.name: Matas Jogėla

entities.summary: Matas Jogėla is a Lithuanian professional basketball player for Dolomiti Energia Trento of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA). A native of Tauragė, he has competed with the Lithuania under-18 team, winning a silver medal.
